content: आभोगः [आ-भुज्-घञ्] .²1 Curving, winding. .²2 A curve; आभोगकुटिला (गङ्गा) <ls>Mb.</ls>; crumpling. .²3 Circuit, circumference, expanse, extension, precincts, environs; अकथितोऽपि ज्ञायत एव यथायमाभोगस्तपावेनस्येति <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; गगनाभोगः the expanse of heaven, wide firmament of the sky; <ls>Bh. 3. 57</ls>; <ls>Mv. 6. 30</ls>; शैलाभोगभुवो भवन्ति ककुभः <ls>Māl. 9. 16</ls>. प्रासादाभोगः the middle part of a palace; प्रासादाभोगविस्तीर्णः स्तुतिशब्दो ह्यवर्तत <ls>Rām. 2. 65. 3</ls>. .²4 Magnitude, fulness, extent, expansive form; गण्डाभोगात् <ls>Me. 93</ls> from the broad cheek; प्रतिरवाभोग <ls>Māl. 3. 8</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">4. 10</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">5. 11</ls>; प्रतिभयाभोगैः प्लवङ्गाधिपैः <ls>Mv. 6. 24</ls> bodily form or stature; <ls>U. 2. 14</ls>; भवाभोगोद्विग्नाः <ls>Bh. 3. 42</ls>, <ls n="Bh. 3.">86</ls>; <ls>Mv. 2</ls>; <ls>K. 305</ls>, <ls n="K.">333</ls>. .²5 Effort. .²6 The expanded hood of a cobra (used by Varuṇa as his umbrella). .²7 Enjoyment, satiety, completion; विषयाभोगेषु नैवादरः <ls>Śāntilakṣaṇa.</ls> .²8 Serpent. आभोगं हन्मना हतम् <ls>Rv. 7. 94. 12</ls>.
